slug: 2025-12-17 Togo Expands Public Service Digitisation With Online Civil Registry Platform

systems.system: Services Publics platform (civil registry copy requests)
systems.owner: ministers of Territorial Administration and Digital Transformation
systems.tiers: pilot in five municipalities: Agoè-Nyivé 1, Golfe 1, Avé 2, Zio 2 and Lacs 1; requests for copies of birth, marriage and death certificates with real-time tracking; gradual extension to all municipalities promised

note: An online system for requesting copies of civil registry documents; nothing on how events are recorded at the office.
